hero.title: Look closer.
hero.description: The more we understand the natural world, the more extraordinary it becomes.
hero.imageAlt: Ray gliding beneath the sunlit surface

origin.heading: A small shark.
paragraphs: Sea More's story begins with a young diver who was wary of sharks. During a first dive course, a small reef shark appeared near the coral. Curiosity replaced fear, and the animal swam away.
That moment started a search to understand these creatures through experience. Sea More was created to offer others the same chance to observe, learn and return with deeper respect.

approach.heading: The right place. The right people.
approach.body: We focus on locations chosen for the wildlife encounter, and work with experienced professionals to help guests make the most of every journey. The wild remains wild; that is part of its wonder.
approach.imageAlt: Whale shark and diver beneath the surface

leader.name: Daniel Flormann.
leader.body: The original site introduces Daniel as a biophysicist, diving instructor and expedition leader with a focus on biology, underwater photography, sharks and crocodiles. Sea More's wider network brings local expertise into each journey.
leader.imageAlt: Daniel Flormann, Sea More expedition leader

items.title: Stay curious
items.body: The best encounter opens a new question, rather than ending a story.

items.title: Know the place
items.body: Thoughtful choices and experienced partners shape the journey.

items.title: Keep it personal
items.body: A good expedition leaves room for each traveler's interests and pace.
